snippet.title: Minesweeper Together Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3550060/Minesweeper_Together/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/svpJwvWQxu

Minesweeper is back, but this time it's together! Minesweeper Together is a logical puzzle board game about revealing cells and avoiding mines cooperatively.

As you reveal cells, you will find numbers that indicate how many mines are surrounding those numbers.

Choose from 5 different difficulties:
- Easy
- Medium
- Hard
- Insane
- Diabolical
The selected difficulty dictates board width, board height, and mine count.
Once you're in the game with up to 3 friends (4 total players), you can all interact with the board and work together to reveal cells and flag mines!

Come play Minesweeper, Together!
